policy: Append-only Test Solution decisions. AI artifacts remain immutable evidence under test. No decision in this register changes AI input files.

promotionRules.CONFIRMED_MATCH: Requires exact canonical source anchor evidence, reviewer, review date, and rationale; heuristic similarity alone is insufficient.
promotionRules.NEW_RULE: Requires independent Test Solution derivation from the ATL105 specification, canonical source anchor, reviewer, review date, and rationale; AI wording cannot be the source.
promotionRules.DUPLICATE: Requires the existing Test Solution rule ID and evidence showing business equivalence.
promotionRules.REJECT: Requires rationale explaining why the AI artifact is unsupported, over-sliced, duplicated, or outside scope.
promotionRules.PENDING: May be created without reviewer evidence while awaiting SME action; never counts toward coverage.
